note: Islamic History order game. Every year is the one a named Wikipedia article states (CE), opened on 20 Nov 2026; 'basis' says exactly what the page states. AH dates are shown only where the page gives one. Years that pages disagree on or leave out (Yarmouk, Karbala, Qadisiyyah, the Great Mosque of Damascus) are not used. Not yet reviewed by a named scholar.
